svg.title: The card as Komorebi runs it
svg.text: host: Python Program, Session and Run
NoC0 coordinates: x right, y down
numbers in cores: Komorebi's core index
X280 1 to 3: a thread each (kmx_main, kmx_par)
a ring each: records to X280 0; events and result words back
regions in its bank: D6 for 1, D7 for 2 and 3
the two panels: one multicast window each
the record, stored to every core
Measured: 0.77 µs per record with 4 in flight to all 120 cores (landing experiment).
Columns 7 and 10 are the Tensix columns fused off on the card used here.
the host ring, three thread rings
